outcome: Labor and delivery protocols for SARS-CoV-2-positive patients
cohort: Obstetrical leaders in four academic medical centers in NYC who were implementing and testing protocols during the height of the COVID-19 pandemic.
finding: All surveyed sites made changes to their practices, showing agreement on COVID-19 screening, testing, and labor and delivery protocols for SARS-CoV-2-positive patients, but less consensus on inpatient antepartum fetal surveillance.
mod_finding: There appeared to be agreement among sites regarding labor and delivery protocols for SARS-CoV-2-positive patients.
cross-section timing: During the height of the COVID-19 pandemic (around May 2020)
